labels.reason: The body contains three dose-specific rows of reported CL, AUC, Cmax and half-life parameters, supported by study, assay and model notes. These are source-backed reported-parameter candidates, without independent validation. No concentration observations or response records are supplied. The PK route is explicitly unstated; efficacy dosing and cyclophosphamide administration do not establish the meropenem PK route. The cited binding value is an input used for fT>MIC, rather than a binding measurement documented here. Requirement links indicate partial input or context support; missing definitions and relationships remain unresolved.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T1:A4 supplies assay and one-compartment-model context but explicitly states that sampling times and mice per time point are unstated and no concentration table or figure was published. Reported parameters do not supply concentration-time observations, sampling identities or independent fit-assessment inputs. MC001 and DR008 remain UNRESOLVED for time-course modeling.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported concentration-time observations and sampling design, if available in authorized evidence; otherwise retain parameter-only status and refer component eligibility or exploratory use to animal PK assessment.

findings.reason: Dose-specific Total CL estimates are available as literature-reported candidates. F0003:S2:T1:A3 explicitly leaves the PK route unstated. Dose composition, absolute CL versus CL/F interpretation, actual body weights, parameter uncertainty and the AUC integration window are NOT_FOUND. Cmax sampling or prediction details and half-life phase are also unspecified.
findings.needed_material: Clarify the PK route, analyte-specific dose basis, clearance definition, AUC window, reported estimation details and uncertainty before dependent use. Preserve the printed estimates without recalculation or independent-validation claims.

findings.reason: MI006 remains OPEN CONFLICT, needed_at pk, originating in main:/missing_information/items/5. F0003:S2:T1:A5 reports Protein binding used for fT>MIC: 10%, cited from S07. It does not resolve the supplied mouse binding-source conflict or establish an uncontested mouse unbound fraction. Measurement method, binding matrix, concentration range, temperature, pH and recovery information are NOT_FOUND here.
findings.needed_material: Document mouse binding provenance and defensible sensitivity treatment under SC028 without averaging conflicting values. Preserve the cited percentage as reported; obtain the applicable source interpretation or responsible review before selecting a binding input. DR009 and MC002 remain UNRESOLVED.

findings.reason: MI008 remains OPEN DEFERRED, needed_at pk, originating in main:/missing_information/items/7. This page contains reported parameters without animal identifiers, sample counts, verified sampling structure or variability definitions. It does not establish empirical individual PK variability for DR010 or later PTA.
findings.needed_material: Assess available experimental units and variability evidence during PK work, distinguish parameter uncertainty from interindividual variability, and retain any limitation for PTA. Do not derive animal variability from these parameter rows.

findings.reason: MI001 remains OPEN NOT_FOUND, needed_at adequacy, originating in main:/missing_information/items/0. This page supplies PK parameters and a binding-use note, without per-regimen CFU responses, strain MICs or a regimen-exposure-response mapping. It does not resolve DR018 or support an independent index comparison.
findings.needed_material: At the adequacy gate, determine whether other authorized response evidence supports the intended comparisons; otherwise retain the limitation without reconstructing missing observations. Keep independent PK and exposure-summary work separate from the unresolved comparison.

findings.reason: MC009, MC010 and MC011 have partial support from reported PK parameters and the cited binding input. This page does not supply a free-concentration profile, matched strain MICs, exposure windows, fT duration-versus-percentage definition, peak evaluation details or response matching. The binding conflict remains open, and uninfected neutropenic PK context does not establish compatibility with a separate infection experiment.
findings.needed_material: Provide source-supported index definitions, exposure windows, matched MICs and regimen-exposure-response relationships, and assess PK/PD experimental compatibility before index analysis. Retain reported AUC and Cmax without assuming free exposure or calculating indices.

findings.reason: The single meropenem doses 30, 100 and 300 mg/kg in F0003:S2:T1:A3 repeat the corresponding table dose values. Age, cyclophosphamide dosing and timing, assay LLOQ and cited protein binding are text-only values with distinct subjects and purposes. No substituted-detection-limit mean flag or uncertainty definition is reported.
findings.needed_material: Carry stated values separately for preparation confirmation, record matching dose statements as duplicates, retain the original units, and preserve cyclophosphamide administration and efficacy-route context separately from the unstated meropenem PK route.
